digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and timezone-aware datetime handling
propositions: Enable Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families in the global configuration after all existing violations across src/rebar and tests are resolved to zero.

Implement explicit UTC timezone semantics in validate_checks.py for epoch timestamp conversion (datetime.fromtimestamp with tz=datetime.timezone.utc) and persisted timestamp strings (strptime().replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)).

Implement security-pin cadence as a host-local calendar-date decision using an aware current instant with explicit timezone argument, converting to host timezone, then extracting the date (datetime.now(tz=datetime.timezone.utc).astimezone().date()).

Prove timezone invariance of UTC cluster keys by running validation behavior under at least two distinct TZ environment settings via time.tzset() on POSIX/macOS platforms, with explicit skip on unsupported platforms.

Establish test_ruff_ratchet.py as the authoritative configuration contract, asserting ASYNC and DTZ selection, absence of security selector S, absence of Semgrep configuration files, and absence of the literal datetime.UTC token from production code.
